title.zh: 谷歌开放跨厂商AI水印检测：ChatGPT图片也能查
title.en: 谷歌开放跨厂商AI水印检测：ChatGPT图片也能查

current_state.zh: Google publicly launched its SynthID Detector worldwide, extending the watermark-checking tool beyond its own models to detect OpenAI, Nvidia and Kakao watermarks in images, video and audio, with Apple set to join.
current_state.en: Google publicly launched its SynthID Detector worldwide, extending the watermark-checking tool beyond its own models to detect OpenAI, Nvidia and Kakao watermarks in images, video and audio, with Apple set to join.
